<div style="font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; color:#1a2744; margin-bottom:10px;">Working Papers</div>
<div style="font-size:0.88rem; color:#444; line-height:1.8;">
<div style="margin-bottom:10px;"><strong>Exploring the Dynamics of the El Niño Southern Oscillation and Food Commodity Prices.</strong> Investigates the impact of ENSO on five major commodity prices (1980–2022) using STAR and STVECM models to capture nonlinear price dynamics.</div>
<div style="margin-bottom:10px;"><strong>Down the Mississippi: How Barge Rates Affect Corn Basis.</strong> Uses a Spatial Durbin Model with weekly data (2014–2024) to examine how barge freight rates and spillover effects shape corn basis along the Mississippi River.</div>
</div>
</div>
